constraints.draft:
Primary pick — Nightfall: The Lightblade (higher-quality loot)
- Why: Nightfalls give better rewards (higher chance at pinnacle/legendary drops, Nightfall-specific loot) than routine Vanguard or story missions.  
- Risk/tradeoff: tougher solo content and can exceed 30 minutes if you struggle — expect some high-health champions or modifier-driven mechanics.

What to do now
- Prep: equip high single-target DPS (precision/boss damage) and strong add-clear tools.  
- Play: focus on clearing adds, avoid unnecessary risks on champions, and burn priority targets quickly to shorten the run. If a boss fight or modifier is slowing you, skip overly risky pushes and reset to safer positions.

Concrete Titan loadout (quick, solo-friendly)
- Subclass: Stomp- or burst‑ability Solar/Strand or the subclass you’re most comfortable with for survivability and burst (use cooldowns to survive champion windows).  
- Primary: a dependable auto/SMG for add clear.  
- Boss DPS: a high-damage sniper/linear fusion/precision kinetic or power rocket/linear fusion depending on your comfort.  
- Heavy: rocket launcher or grenade launcher with cluster/tracking for burst boss damage.  
- Mods/Extras: healing/resilience mods and ammo/ability economy where available.

Backup — one Vanguard Ops or Haunted Altars of Sorrow
- Why: easier to finish inside 30 minutes and still award good legendary rewards and Vanguard progression.

improvement.message: Look at my current Titan build. What's the single biggest improvement I could make?
improvement.live_answer:
Single biggest improvement: swap the gauntlets' Heavy Handed mod for a Hand Cannon loader (or Precision Weapon Loader) to massively improve Rose’s reload/handling and make your gunplay smoother and more forgiving.

Why: you already have Rose (Opening Shot + Rampage) and Synthoceps—so your build is melee-forward but also weapon-focused. Improving hand‑cannon reload/handling gives you more consistent DPS windows with Rose (faster follow-up shots and faster reloads), which benefits almost every activity more than the currently equipped gauntlet mod.

What to do in-game (one change):
- Go to Inventory -> Armor -> Gauntlets (Synthoceps).  
- Remove Heavy Handed and insert Hand Cannon Loader (or Precision Weapon Loader) into a mod socket.  
- If you want the handling boost specifically, choose Hand Cannon Loader; if you prefer faster precision-weapon reload speed, use Precision Weapon Loader.
